rows.en: Assistant: "*pant pant pant pant*... D-Doctor...
I-I can't go on!"
Murk: "Such poor stamina, at your age.
I'm still bursting with energy!"
Assistant: "D-Doctor, you just rode on 'Little Balu,'
didn't you?! I ran all the way here..."
Murk: "Don't call it a feeble name like 'Little Balu.'
It may be small, but it's a perfectly respectable Baluamy."
Assistant: "You can't change the subject like that!"
Murk: "...O-Oh! Is that the rumored Spirit Mech?!"
Assistant: "Whenever things get awkward,
you always try to dodge the issue like that..."
Murk: "If you fuss over every little detail,
you'll never become a proper Alchemist.
More importantly, to have defeated that, even if it is still incomplete..."
Assistant: "Doctor, that Armored Mech..."
Murk: "That must be the rumored Spirit Mech.
Hmm... Its performance lives up to the rumors.
And that ship, Liebhofen, is so powerful...
That's it! Um, you. What was your name again?"
Assistant: "...Marsha Monsian.
This is the one thousand two hundred and fortieth time..."
Murk: "Oh, sorry, sorry. Um..."
Assistant: "It's Marsha... *sniff*"
Murk: "Well, never mind such petty details.
Assistant. Did you record everything properly?"
Assistant: "Y-Yes! Of course, Doctor!
As you can s..."
Murk: "...What's wrong?"
Assistant: "H-Ha ha ha ha...
I didn't put a disc in..."
Murk: "Two points off. Four more, and I'll use your brain
for research."
Assistant: "Oh, Doctor, always joking..."
Murk: "..."
Assistant: "Y-Yes... I'll be more careful..."
Celica: "Hi, everyone! Have you been well?"
Clovis: "You... Were you trying to kill us?"
Celica: "You're all safe, so it's fine.
'All's well that ends well.'"
Ymir: "But why are you aboard Liebhofen?"
Clovis: "That's right. Didn't you go back
to Agarthia?"
Fain: "Heh... A champion of justice always appears gallantly
when his comrades are in danger."
Clovis: "...Well, Celica?"
Fain: "Hey! Don't ignore me!"
Celica: "Well, actually..."
Fain: "Aah, even the princess... *sob sob sob*"
Ymir: "Oh... U-Um... Thank you, Fain."
Fain: "What?! Oh, no, th-that's..."
Ymir: "But don't do anything so reckless again."
Fain: "Y-Yes! If you say so, Ymir,
I, Fain Jin Barion, swear on my life
to keep that promise!!"
Clovis: "...He's easy to read."
Arthur: "Well, what's wrong with that?
He's free to have feelings for whoever he likes."
Celica: "...Um, what were we talking about?
Oh, right. Why we're here.
Well, to put it simply, it was my brother's instruction."
Ymir: "Prince Lodis's?"
Celica: "Right. I wasn't happy about that return order myself.
Because..."
Fain: "P-Princess!"
Celica: "It's fine. They'll find out soon enough anyway.
We were ordered to return because Agarthian intelligence
had learned of Zigrim's invasion."
Touya: "What?! You knew and ran away?!"
Yamato: "Touya!"
Celica: "It's only natural you'd think that.
But we only learned the truth after leaving Flamuelk Castle.
That was when we found out."
Celica: "So my brother had at least us
get off along the way."
Clovis: "So Agarthia itself
buried the information?"
Celica: "Unfortunately. Someone who'd do that...
It must have been Marshal Revios."
Arthur: "Speaking of Revios, isn't he the Agarthian army's
supreme commander?"
Celica: "Yes. The marshal wants to label Zigrim an invading country,
proclaim our own side's righteousness,
and use that as a pretext for war with Zigrim.
To show that we're the leading country on the continent,
a strong Agarthia."
Gabon: "I'd like you to introduce us sometime, too..."
Celica: "Huh? Oh, sorry.
Come to think of it, we haven't introduced the crew yet.
Not everyone's here, but I'll introduce those who are."
Celica: "Um, first, Gabon, our engineer and ship's doctor."
Touya: "Oh, you're..."
Gabon: "Gabon Jin Boleisho. Good to meet you.
Is that little cat doing well?"
Yamato: "We meet again!"
Gabon: "Oh, you look well.
How's it going? Have you gotten used to that life?"
Yamato: "Hmm, sometimes my head feels foggy,
but mostly, there aren't any problems."
Gabon: "That's encouraging. Well, I'm counting on you from now on."
Celica: "Next is Baren, our helmsman, who also does maintenance."
Baren: "...Baren Jin Jokul."
Touya: "...Hey, is he in a bad mood?"
Celica: "He's embarrassed.
He may not look it, but he's quite shy."
Touya: "Oh..."
Celica: "Um, next is Miyasco, our operator.
She's also a qualified doctor."
Miyasco: "Miyasco Ginia Bramble.
I hope we'll all get along."
Touya: "Oh, that voice... I see. You really helped us back there.
Without that data, we'd all have been burned to a crisp
before we knew it."
Miyasco: "Oh, no... I only did what I should."
Celica: "Well, then. I think that's about..."
Derock: "Th-That's terrible.
I'm here, too."
Clovis: "...What's that big guy?"
Celica: "Oh, don't mind him. He's a mirage."
Derock: "That's terrible. I've done so much for you, Princess.
You were just toying with me after all..."
Celica: "D-Don't say things that give people the wrong idea!
How on earth could you interpret anything
to reach a conclusion like that?!"
Derock: "Heh... Heh heh heh."
Celica: "Aah! All right!
I just have to introduce you properly, right?!
Derock, our navigator and gunnery officer.
His gunnery skills are among the best on the continent.
...Unfortunately."
Derock: "Well, since it's you, Lady Celica,
I'll make a special exception and forgive you. I'm Derock Jin Eikak.
Please go easy on me."
Touya: "We've got quite a character here..."
Ymir: "The rest of the crew are due to join us in the Holy Land."
Touya: "The rest?"
Ymir: "The observer, the purser, and...
the captain. Three people."
Touya: "The captain... Now that you mention it, there's no one who looks the part."
Clovis: "Well, Ymir as captain might suit her
quite nicely."
Ymir: "No, I'm not really suited for..."
Arthur: "I'd heard about it, but
I never thought Liebhofen would be this impressive..."
Celica: "Heh heh... Right?
It's absolutely incredible!
Overall length, 309 leek, or 463 meters!
Maximum output, an astonishing forty million horsepower!
And a top speed of 533 risleek,
or Mach 0.98!
What's more, aside from supply requirements, it can operate
almost indefinitely. It's a 'standalone type' mothership,
and with its autonomous system, it can be operated by a minimum of eight
people! That's Liebhofen for you!"
Touya: "Eight people...? There are only five here."
Celica: "Well, never mind the little details..."
Touya: "...Is that how it works?"
Celica: "At present, the only ship on the whole continent with performance like this
is Liebhofen.
And, and there's more..."
Ai: "Stop! Never mind that. Let's get back, quickly!
We don't have time to dawdle!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah, you're right.
We've joined up with Liebhofen, so if we hurry..."
Celica: "Wh-What?!"
Miyasco: "...That!"
Fain: "Black smoke..."
Arthur: "That's... Flamuelk Castle!"
???: "So this is the end of York...
It was surprisingly quick... Hm?"
???: "...Is that Liebhofen?
...Looks like it was a little too late, though... Heh heh heh."
